facts.fact: Togo's Ministry of Public Service Efficiency and Digital Transformation, with GIZ and Simplon, started a six-week data science certification course at the Togo Data Lab on 14 April 2026 for public administration professionals, aiming at 60 civil servants among 260 trainees.
facts.system: Programme certifiant en Data Science (Togo Data Lab, Simplon)

facts.fact: Togo's digital ministry and GIZ launched a Simplon data science certification at the Togo Data Lab, with a first cohort of students and young professionals from 13 April 2026, targeting 260 local trainees.
